title: AHB Read, Write, Wait, and Error Completion
description: Follow address and data owners, distinguish the selected subordinate's HREADYOUT from muxed global HREADY, and inspect an ordinary OKAY wait before the required two-cycle AHB-Lite/AHB5 ERROR response.

annotations.message: Read data phase for address 0x100: the slave drives HRDATA=0xBEEF while the master presents the next write address.
Write data phase for address 0x104: the master drives HWDATA=0xCAFE while the error-producing read address is issued.
The selected slave inserts an ordinary wait for failing read 0xBAD: HREADYOUT=0 and HRESP=OKAY. The return mux presents those values as global HREADY/HRESP because this slave owns the data phase.
ERROR cycle 1: the selected slave drives HRESP=ERROR and HREADYOUT=0; the global return path preserves that data-owner response.
ERROR cycle 2: HRESP remains ERROR and HREADYOUT returns HIGH. Muxed HREADY is HIGH, so the manager samples error completion on this edge.
